snippet.title: PAW Patrol Dino World | Announce Trailer | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
🦖🐾 Parents, the adventure is getting bigger. 

In PAW Patrol Dino World, Marshall, Chase, and Skye lead an epic new mission. This all-new video game expands the upcoming PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie universe, bringing it to life in an open, interactive world your child can freely explore. 

From story-driven missions to dinosaur rescues and hands-on exploration, kids will use each pup’s special abilities to solve challenges and uncover surprises across Dino World. 

Learn more about this immersive new PAW Patrol adventure 👉 https://outrightgames.com/game/paw-patrol-dino-world/

#PAWPatrolDinoWorld #PAWPatrol #NickJr
